And Shema said to Mushi: “Behold, you are about to lie down with your fathers, and this people will rise up, and play the whore after the foreign gods of the land, to which they go to be among them, and they will forsake me, and break my covenant which I have made with them.

Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be plunder, and many evils and troubles shall come upon them. And they will say in that day, ‘Behold, evils have come upon us because our God is not with us!ʼ
And I will surely hide my face from them in that day for all the evil which they wrought, when they turned to other gods.
Now therefore write this song for you, and teach it the children of Yishraʾel. Put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Yishraʾel.

For when I shall have brought them to the land which I swore to their fathers to give them, flowing with milk and honey, and they shall eat and be full, and grow fat, then they will turn to other gods, and serve them, and despise me, and break my covenant.

And when many evils and troubles have come upon them, this song shall testify before them as a witness, for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their offspring, for I know their inclination which they form today, before I have brought them into the land which I swore to his fathers.”
And Mushi wrote this song the same day, and taught it to the children of Yishraʾel.
And he gave Yeʾusha the son of Non a charge, and said: “Be strong and firm, for you shall bring the children of Yishraʾel into the land, which I swore to them, and I will be with you.”
And when Mushi had finished writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,
Mushi commanded the Libites, who bore the ark of the covenant of Shema, saying:
“Take this book of the law, and put it by the side of the ark of the covenant of Shema your God, that it may be there for a witness against you.
For I know your rebellion, and your stiff neck. Behold, while I am yet alive with you today, you have been rebellious against Shema, and how much more after my death!
Assemble to me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their hearing, and call heaven and earth to witness against them.

For I know that after my death you will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you, and evil will befall you in the latter days, because you will do that which is evil in the sight of Shema, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.”
And Mushi spoke in the hearing of all the assembly of Yishraʾel the words of this song, until they were finished:
“Give ear, O heavens, and I will speak; and let the earth hear the words of my mouth.
My teaching shall drop as the rain, my speech shall flow as the dew, as gentle rain upon grass, and as showers upon the herb.
For I will invoke the name of Shema, and ascribe greatness to our God.
The rock, his work is perfect, for all his ways are justice. A God of faithfulness and without iniquity, just and right is he.
They have dealt corruptly, not his [are] the children of blemish, a generation perverse and crooked.
Do you thus requite Shema, O foolish people and unwise? Behold, he is your father that possesses you! He has made you, and established you.
Remember the days of old, consider the years of all generations. Ask your father, and he will inform you; your elders, and they will tell you.
When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the children of men, he set the boundaries of peoples according to the number of the children of Yishraʾel.
For Shemaʼs portion is his people Yāqob; the lot of his inheritance is Yishraʾel.
He strengthened him in the desert, and set him in praise. He encircled him, and he adopted him as a son, and he guarded him as [one guards] the pupil of his eye.
As an eagle that stirs up its nest, and over its young hovers, spreading out his wings, and he takes them. He bears them on his pinion.
Shema alone led him, and there was no foreign god with him.
He made him ride on the high places of the earth, he fed him [with] the yield of the field. He made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock.
Butter of the herd, and milk of the flock, with butter of lambs and rams, herds of Bashan and goats, with the finest of the wheat, and of the blood of grape you drank wine.
Yāqob ate and was sated, Yasharon waxed fat and kicked. You waxed fat, you grew thick, you became beautiful. Then he forsook God who made him, and they spurned the rock of his salvation.
They stirred him to jealousy with alien [gods], and with the abominations they provoked him to anger.
They sacrificed to demons, which were not gods, gods that they had not known, [to] new ones that came in of late, whom your fathers did not fear.
The rock who begot you, you disdained, and have forgotten the God who praised you.
And Shema saw [it], and became vexed, because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters.
And he said, ʻI will hide my face from them, and I will see what their end shall be, for they are a generation of perversity, sons in whom there is no faithfulness.
They have angered me with what is no god; they have enraged me with their idols. So I will anger them with those who are no people, with a foolish nation I will enrage them.
For a fire is kindled by my anger, and it burns to the lowest Sheol. It devours the earth with its increase. It sets on fire the foundations of the mountains.
I will gather evils upon them. And my arrows I will spend upon them.
From this hunger their food is flame. Striving predators and teeth of beasts I will send upon them, with venom of creepers in dust.
In the open shall the sword bereave, in chambers shall be terror. [Destroying] both young man and virgin and suckling [child] with the man of age.
I said, ʻthey provoke me to anger, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men,ʼ
were it not that I feared the provocation of my enemy, lest our adversaries should boast themselves, lest they should say, ʻOur hands prevailed, Shema has not done all this.ʼ
For they are a nation void of its counsel, there is no understanding in them.
They are not wise, and [do not] understand this, and [do not] consider their latter end.
How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their rock had sold them, and Shema had delivered them up?
For their rock is not as our rock, [still] our enemies are hopeful.
For their vine is of the vine of Sadem, and of the grapevine of Emirra. Their grapes are grapes of poison, and their clusters are bitter.
Their wine is poison of serpents, hostile venom of asps.
Behold, it is stored with me, sealed up in my storehouses!
To the day of vengeance and recompense, at the time when their foot shall slide. For the day of their calamity is at hand, and their doom comes swiftly.
For Shema will vindicate his people, and have compassion for his servants, when he sees that [their] power is gone, and there is none remaining, bond or free.
And they will say, ʻWhere are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge,
which ate the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them rise up and help you, let them be your protection.ʼ
See now that I, even I, am he, and there is no god beside me. I kill, and I make live; I wound, and I heal. And there is none that can deliver out of my hand.
For I lift up my hand to the heaven, and say, ʻAs I live forever,
if I whet my glittering sword, and my hand takes hold on judgment, I will render vengeance to my adversaries, and will requite those who hate me.
I will make my arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh; with the blood of the slain and the captives, from the head of the enemyʼs rioters.ʼ
Praise, O nations, his people, for he will avenge the blood of his servants, and will render vengeance to his adversaries, and will make expiation for the land of his people.”
And Mushi came and spoke all the words of this song in the hearing of the people, he and Yeʾusha the son of Non.
And when Mushi finished speaking these words to all Yishraʾel,
he said to them: “Set your heart to all the words which I testify to you today, which you shall command your children to observe and to do, all the words of this law.
For it is no vain thing for you, because it is your life, and through this thing you shall prolong your days in the land, which you go over the Yardan to possess.”
And Shema spoke to Mushi on that very day, saying:
“Go up this Mount Aʾibrem, Mount Naba, which is in the land of Muwwab, which is opposite Yariyyu, and behold the land of Kaˈnan, which I give to the children of Yishraʾel for a possession.
And die on the mountain which you ascend, and be gathered to your people, as Ārron your brother died in Mount Ar, and was gathered to his people,

because you trespassed against me in the midst of the children of Yishraʾel at the waters of Maribat-qadesh, in the wilderness of Ṣen, because you did not sanctify me in the midst of the children of Yishraʾel.
For you shall see the land before you, but you shall not go into the land which I give the children of Yishraʾel.”
And this is the blessing, with which Mushi the man of God blessed the children of Yishraʾel before his death.
And he said: “Shema came from Sini, and rose from Shaʾer to them. He shone forth from Mount Farran, with him ten of thousands of holy ones. At his right hand was a fiery law for them.
Yea, he is beloved by peoples, and all his consecrated ones are in your charge. And they are submitted at your feet, receiving your words.
Mushi commanded us a law, an inheritance [for] the assembly of Yāqob.
There was a king in Yasharon, when the heads of the people gathered, all the tribes of Yishraʾel together.
May Reʾuben live, and not die, and may from him be a number.
And this is for Yeʾuda, and he said, ʻHear, Shema, the voice of Yeʾuda, and bring him in to his people. His hand is his struggle, and you shall be a help against his adversaries.’
And of Libi he said, ʻYour Thummim and your Urim are with your loyal one, whom you did test at Massa, and strove at the waters of Mariba,
who said of his father and of his mother, ʻI have not seen,ʼ neither did he acknowledge his brother, nor knew he his own child. For they have observed your word, and keep your covenant.
They shall teach Yāqob your ordinances, and Yishraʾel your laws. They shall put incense before you, and whole burned offering upon your altar.
Bless, Shema, his substance, and accept the work of his hand, crush the loins of his adversaries, and of his enemies, who can rouse them?’
And of Binyamem he said, ʻBy the might of Shema shall he dwell in safety, and he covers him all the day long, and he dwells between his shoulders.ʼ
And of Yusef he said, ʻBlessed of Shema is his land, with bounty of heaven, with dew, and with the deep that crouches beneath,
and with the bounty of yield of the sun, and with the bounty of growth of the months,
and with the bounty of the ancient mountains, and with the bounty of the everlasting hill,

and with the finest produce of the earth and its fullness, and the good will of him that dwells in the bush. [Let] its harvest [be] on the head Yusef, and on the leader, the one crowned [among] his brothers.

The firstling of a bull, majesty is his, and his horns are the horns of a wild-ox. With them he shall gore peoples, together the ends of the earth. They are the ten thousands of Ifrem, and they are the thousands of Manashi.ʼ
And of Zebulan he said, ʻRejoice, Zebulan, in your going out, and Yashishakar, in your tents.
Peoples shall be summoned to My mountain, and there shall they offer sacrifices of righteousness. For they shall suck abundance of seas, and hidden treasures of sand.ʼ
And of Gad he said, ʻBlessed be he who enlarges Gad. He couches like a lioness, tearing arm and brow.

And he chose the first part for himself, for there was the lawgiverʼs portion reserved. And he admonished the heads of the people. He executed the righteousness of Shema, and his ordinances with Yishraʾel.ʼ
And of Dan he said, ʻDan is a lionʼs whelp, and he leaps forth from the Bashan.ʼ
And of Niftali he said, ʻNiftali is sated and favoured, and full with the blessing of Shema, possesses west and south.ʼ
And of Asher he said, ʻBlessed be Asher above children, and let him be acceptable to his brothers, and let him dip his feet in oil.
Your bars are iron and brass, and as your days, so is your greatness.ʼ
There is none like God, O Yasharon, [who] rides upon heavens for your help, and in his excellency on skies,
the abode of the eternal God. And underneath his everlasting arms. And he thrust out the enemy from before you. And said, ʻI shall destroy.ʼ
And Yishraʾel dwells in safety, the fountain of Yāqob alone, on a land of grain and new wine, and even your heavens drop down dew.

Happy are you, Yishraʾel. Who is like you, the people saved by Shema, the shield of your help, and the sword of your excellency! And your enemies shall submit themselves to you, and you shall tread upon their high place.”

And Mushi went up from the plains of Muwwab to Mount Naba, to the top of Affasga, which is opposite Yariyyu. And Shema showed him all the land from the river of Miṣrem to the great river, the river Farat, and to the western sea.

And Shema said to him: “This is the land which I swore to your fathers, to Abˈram, to Yeˈṣaq, and to Yāqob, saying, ʻI will give it to your offspring.ʼ I have caused you to see it with your eyes, but you shall not go over there.”
So Mushi the servant of Shema died there in the land of Muwwab, according to the word of Shema.
And he buried him in Giyya in the land of Muwwab, opposite Bet-fūr, but no man knows the place of his burial to this day.
And Mushi was one hundred and twenty years old when he died. His eyes were not dim, nor his vitality abated.
And the children of Yishraʾel wept for Mushi in the plain of Muwwab thirty days. Then the days of weeping in the mourning for Mushi ended.
And Yeʾusha the son of Non was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Mushi had laid his hand upon him. And the children of Yishraʾel obeyed him, and did as Shema commanded Mushi.
And there has not arisen since a prophet in Yishraʾel like Mushi, whom Shema knew face to face,
in all the signs and the wonders, which Shema sent him to do in the land of Miṣrem, to Faru, and to all his servants, and to all his land,
and in all the mighty hand, and in all the great vision, which Mushi performed in the sight of all Yishraʾel. ENDNOTES
